Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and players make their way out to the middle. Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock will open the innings for South Africa. Alzarri Joseph will start with the first new ball for West Indies. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, West Indies will certainly be the happier side at the halfway mark courtesy of the late fightback with the bat. The onus is now on their bowlers to see them past the finishing line. On the other hand, South Africa will be a bit disappointed with their bowling effort towards the end. The hosts will need to bat out of their skins to chase down this total. Will their batters rise to the challenge? We shall find out soon. Back in a bit for the chase...

After losing the toss, Temba Bavuma was hoping for some early inroads from his new ball bowlers but they were unable to do so. They kept missing their lines and lengths consistently and allowed West Indies to get off to a flier. South Africa pulled things back towards the latter stages of the first Powerplay reducing West Indies to 71-3 in the space of a couple of overs. They bowled well in patches but got breakthroughs just when a partnership was blossoming. However, they were unable to get rid of Shai Hope and they were blown away by his onslaught. Moreover, South Africa did not manage to finish well, conceding 40 runs in the last three overs. Gerald Coetzee was the pick of the bowlers with figures of 3 for 57 from his 10 overs while Bjorn Fortuin and Tabraiz Shamsi accounted for two wickets each.

West Indies finish on a high and end up with a formidable total on the board. After Shai Hope called it right and opted to bat first, Brandon King and Kyle Mayers got West Indies off to a flying start. Kyle Mayers in particular did not shy away from putting away the loose deliveries. However, they were pegged back losing three wickets in quick succession. Shai Hope then came in and steadied the ship for the visitors despite wickets falling at the other end. Nicholas Pooran and Rovman Powell both got off to starts but were unable to carry on. At 279-6, West Indies were in danger of being bowled out inside the 50 overs but Shai Hope stood strong and stroked an unbeaten knock of 128 runs to help his side cross the 330-run mark.

FOUR! Fullish delivery outside off, Shai Hope goes deep in his crease and slices it wide of short third man for a boundary. 16 runs come off the final over and West Indies end up with 335 runs on the board.
SIX! THUMPED! Slower and short outside off, Shai Hope picks the change of pace and waits for the ball to arrive. Flat bats this one well over long on for a maximum.
Short and outside off, Alzarri Joseph pulls it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Low full toss at the stumps, Shai Hope gets surprised a bit but still manages to knock it down to long off for a run.

Cutterr on a back of a length, Shai Hope tries to go down the ground but plays it too early. Skies this one high in the air towards long off where Wayne Parnell fails to read the bounce and concedes the second run.
Slower and into the wicket on off, Shai Hope slaps it to the left of long off and collects a couple of runs.
It will be Lungi Ngidi to bowl the final over.
Short and flatter on leg, Alzarri Joseph can only push this one back to the bowler.
Short and quicker on leg, Alzarri Joseph looks to clip but misses.
Short again and on leg, Shai Hope pulls it along the ground to deep square leg for a run.
Floated, full on middle, Alzarri Joseph lofts it back over the bowler's head and towards long off for a run.

SIX! Alzarri Joseph gets into the act now! Short and on leg by Tabraiz Shamsi, Alzarri Joseph waits for it and allows the ball to come to him. Pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for his first maximum.
Short and on leg, Shai Hope rocks back and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Full this time and on middle, Alzarri Joseph drives it hard but straight to extra cover.

FOUR! Streaky but they all count! Slower and on a length on off, Alzarri Joseph tries to push this one on the off side but gets an outside edge. The ball beats Lungi Ngidi at short third man and races away to the fence.
Full and drifting at the pads, Shai Hope whips it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Back of a length on middle, Shai Hope pulls this one wide of deep mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs more.
Full and on leg, Shai Hope clears his front leg and slogs it towards mid-wicket. The ball goes miles up in the air and falls short of the rushing deep mid-wicket fielder. Two runs taken.
SIX! Cracking shot! Full and angling in on off from 'round the wicket, Shai Hope makes room and goes inside out. Carves it over point for a maximum.
Short and outside off, Alzarri Joseph hangs back and defends it to point.

HUNDRED for Shai Hope! Short and on middle by Tabraiz Shamsi, Shai Hope picks the length early and pulls it to deep square leg for a single to bring up the three-figure mark. The skipper has truly led from the front for West Indies.
Short and turning in on middle, Alzarri Joseph rocks back and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Googly again, short and outside off, Alzarri Joseph pushes it to cover for a dot.
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Tabraiz Shamsi strikes again and removes Odean Smith! Bowls a googly, short and on off, Odean Smith goes deep in his crease and tries to work it on the leg side. Gets into a tangle and fails to get bat to ball. The ball deflects off the front pad and goes on to hit the off stump. West Indies slip further as they are now 8 wickets down.
Short and turning into the pads, Shai Hope goes back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller this time at the stumps, Shai Hope drives it to long on for a single and keeps the strike.
Short of a length on middle, Shai Hope tries to run it down to third man but misses.
Banged in short and on leg, Shai Hope gets inside the line and helps it wide of fine leg for a couple of runs. Moves to 97.
Full and on middle, Odean Smith drives it firmly to mid off and gets off the mark with a single.
Another on a yorker length on middle, Odean Smith watchfully blocks this one out.
Odean Smith comes in at number 9.

OUT! LBW! Marco Jansen comes back and strikes straightaway! Starts with a searing yorker on leg, Akeal Hosein stays back and looks to flick this one. He gets beaten for pace and the ball catches him on the front toe. South Africa go up in unison and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Akeal Hosein has a word with Shai Hope and goes up for a review. The UltraEdge shows no bat and it is hitting the wickets on Ball Tracking. Akeal Hosein isn't pleased but he has to make the long walk back now.
Marco Jansen (8-1-58-0) is back on.
SIX! Straight as an arrow! Flighted delivery, full outside off, Shai Hope gets down on one knee and lofts it back over the bowler's head for a maximum. Moves to 95 with this maximum.
Full and turning away around off, Akeal Hosein presses forward and pushes it to long off for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Akeal Hosein gets behind the line and defends.
Short and turning down the leg side, Shai Hope tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Akeal Hosein knocks it down to long on for a single.
Akeal Hosein comes out to bat.

OUT LBW! What a review by South Africa! Tabraiz Shamsi floats this one full and turning in on leg, Jason Holder pulls out the reverse sweep but does not connect. The ball catches him on the left arm and in front of the stumps. The umpire's finger stays down and Temba Bavuma sends it upstairs for a review. The UltraEdge shows no bat and it is three reds on Ball Tracking. The on-field decision is overturned and Jason Holder has to depart.
Tabraiz Shamsi (7-0-41-0) returns to the attack.
Slower and into the wicket on middle, Jason Holder pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good-length on off, Jason Holder dabs it to backward point for a dot.
Banged in short and around off, Jason Holder goes for the pull but gets a top edge that travels towards fine leg. Tabraiz Shamsi fumbles a bit and concedes the second run.
FIVE WIDES! Lungi Ngidi loses his radar and sprays it way down the leg side. Neither keeper nor the batter manage to get on the end of it and it goes for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Shai Hope drills it down to long on for a run.
Two Leg byes! Fullish delivery angling in on leg, Shai Hope goes for the clip but gets hit on the back leg. The ball rolls to third man for a couple of runs.

SIX! Shai Hope greets Lungi Ngidi with a maximum! Starts with a full delivery around off, Shai Hope picks the length early and lets his hangs go through with the shot. Thumps it well over long off for a maximum.
Short and on off, Shai Hope cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Full and on midle and leg, Jason Holder works it to long on for a single.
Short and at the stumps, Shai Hope pushes it down to long off for a single.
SIX! Shai Hope goes huge! Tossed up, full and slower on leg, Shai Hope clears his front leg and slogs it well over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Angled in full and on leg, Jason Holder clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Darted in full and on middle, Shai Hope slog sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Shai Hope drags this one down to long on for a single.
Sees the batter advance and bowls it short outside off, Shai Hope reaches out to this delivery but fails to connect.
Short and outside off, Jason Holder cuts it to deep cover and settles for a single.
On a good length and slower on off, Jason Holder goes for a swipe across the line and misses. The ball goes just short over the off stump.
FOUR! Full this and outside off, Jason Holder gets across and lofts it back over the bowler's head for his first boundary. This should break the shackles for West Indies.
Short and outside off, Jason Holder stays leg side of the ball and swings his bat at it. Ends up missing the ball altogether.
Short and outside off, Shai Hope uses his feet and cuts hard but does not manage to beat cover.
Floated, full on leg, Shai Hope presses forward and works it to cover.
Fuller this time and on leg, Jason Holder flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Jason Holder steps out and slaps it back to the bowler.
Short and flatter on middle, Shai Hope punches it down to long off for a run.
Full and quicker on middle, Jason Holder knocks it down to long on for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! South Africa can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle. Also, Bjorn Fortuin comes into the attack.
Banged in short at the batter, Jason Holder gets hurried but still manages to pull this one to deep square leg for a run.
Nails the yorker on off, Jason Holder jams this one to cover for a dot.
Back of a length on middle, Shai Hope guides this one to the left of backward point and takes a quick single.
Another short delivery on middle, Shai Hope goes for the pull but misses and wears it on the body.
Short and around off by Gerald Coetzee, Jason Holder swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller this time and outside off, Jason Holder drives it on the bounce to point for a dot.
Short and angling in at the batter, Shai Hope pulls but finds mid-wicket. A maiden by Marco Jansen.
Low full toss at the stumps, Shai Hope drives it straight to mid off. Five dots on the trot by Marco Jansen.
Slower and full outside off, Shai Hope gets deceived by the pace of the delivery and gets beaten on the drive.
Low full toss just outside off stump, Shai Hope goes for the drive but misses. That should have been put away by Shai Hope.
Fullish delivery on middle, Shai Hope gets his bat down in time and digs it out to extra cover.
On a good length and angling in on middle, Shai Hope clips this one to mid on.
Back of a length again and on middle, Shai Hope hops and taps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length at the batter, Jason Holder stays back and fends it towards backward square leg for a run.
Back of a length on middle by Gerald Coetzee, Jason Holder hangs back to work it on the leg side but closes the bat face early. Gets a leading edge that falls short of mid-wicket.
Tries to go full but ends up bowling a full toss on middle, Jason Holder pushes this one towards mid on for a dot.
Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Rovman Powell is compeltely devastated with that shot and let's out a huge grunt of disbelief. Gerald Coetzee comes back in and picks up his third wicket. This is bowled slower and shorter outside off. Powell hangs deep and tries to drag it through mid-wicket. Powell ends up reaching for it and is early in the pull. The ball takes the inside edge and goes on to crash into the stumps.
Back of a length outside off, eased through cover-point for one.
FOUR! Short of a length around leg stump, pulled away crisply by Rovman Powell in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Slower one, dug in over middle and angling in. Shai Hope gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, sliced down to third man for yet another single.
On a good length and outside off, steered wide of the man at third man for one more.
Full and around off, Shai Hope gets the drive in between extra cover and mid off. Temba Bavuma from mid off chases it down and keeps it down to a couple of runs.
Good length around off, Rovman Powell looks to push at it but gets an outside edge down to third man for one.
A gentle full toss angling down leg, Rovman Powell flicks it off the legs down to fine leg for just a single.
Very full and angled into the leg pole, Rovman Powell jams it out.
Fullish length around off, this is driven nicely through cover for a single.
Length ball around off, pushed toward mid off for a single.
SIX! Easy power from Rovman Powell! Pitched up around off, Powell just holds his shape and launches it well over the long off fence for a biggie.
SIX! BANG! Back of a length around off, Rovman Powell hangs back and flat-bats it right back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Nagging length on off stump, turning away a touch, Shai Hope gets pushed back while looking to block and gets hit on the pads.
SIX! Exquisite stroke from Shai Hope! This is tossed up around off, Hope opens up the off side and goes inside-out over extra cover and the ball sails over the fence.
On off stump, knocked down to long off for a single.
Flatter delivery on off stump, punched off the back foot toward the bowler.
Bjorn Fortuin sees Rovman Powell stepping out and fires it in on middle, Powell manages to keep it out.
Floated up on middle, Shai Hope backs away and drives it down to wide long off for a single.
A good bumper this, over middle and at a difficult height as well, Rovman Powell leaves it alone.

Pitched up on off stump, Rovman Powell gets pushed back and edges it toward point. Shai Hope is a long way down and Bjorn Fortuin gets to the ball quickly from backward point but slips and allows Hope to scamper back.
Pitches it a bit further up around middle, angling in. Rovman Powell heaves it off the inside half of the bat behind square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Back of a length around off, Hope eases it off the back foot in front of covers for a run.
Hits the length hard and bowls it outside off, angling it in. Shai Hope looks to punch it away but gets an inside edge onto the boot.
Good length outside off, this is tapped away to deep point for a single.
Tidy over from Bjorn Fortuin, just the single off it. This is pushed through around off, Shai Hope blocks it out.
Full and around off, driven sweetly but can't get it past extra cover.
Pulls the length back a bit and bowls it on off stump, Shai Hope looks to step out but adjusts well to block it out.
Outside off, stump, driven down to long off for a single.
Drifts this one onto middle and leg, Rovman Powell defends it out.
Angling in from outside off, punched on the up to extra cover.
Pitched up on middle, Shai Hope mistimes the drive off the inner half of the bat and gets it toward mid on.
Length ball around off, played softly in front of mid off for a quick single. Excellent running yet again.

This is dug in short again over middle and off, Shai Hope pulls it toward deep mid-wicket where the fielder from deep square leg runs to his left and gets a hand on it. The batters do extremely well to race back for the third run.
This is full and on the legs, clipped away through square leg for a run.
WIDE! Full and wide outside the off stump, spilled beyond the tramline, left alone for a wide.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for one more.
This is dug in short over middle, Rovman Powell pulls it through mid-wicket and picks up a single.

Drinks break! It has been steady going here for West Indies after they lost three wickets early on. Nicholas Pooran and Shai Hope stitched together a good stand and kept the scoreboard ticking along nicely. Pooran fell though and after that Hope has managed to put on another stand with Rovman Powell. The scoring rate has come down a bit but with still 19 overs remaining West Indies have a good platform to get well over 300 runs here. South Africa have done well to put a plug on the boundaries but will need to pick up wickets in order to restrict the Windies to a chasable score.
Bowled on a nagging length around off and sticking in the surface, Shai Hope gets take aback but manages to block it off the back foot.
Flatter one around off, nudged away in front of cover-point for a quick single.
A tad shorter on off stump and gripping a bit in the surface. Rovman Powell stays watchful and keeps it out.
FOUR! Drops it short and outside off, Rovman Powell stays back and cuts it late through backward point for a boundary.
Flatter one on off and middle, kept out by Powell.

This is full and outside off, Shai Hope leans on and drives it firmly to sweeper cover for a single. And, that will be FIFTY for Hope, what a crucial inning this could turn out to be from the skipper.
Hard length over off stump, Rovman Powell gets behind the line to block.
Good length around off, pushed out in front of cover for a run.

Full and on middle and leg, right in the blockhole. Rovman Powell looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls toward backward point and they get a single. There is an appeal for LBW which is dismissed and the batters get across for a leg bye.
This is pitched up around middle, angling in, Shai Hope pushes it straight back to the left of mid off and scampers through for a single.
Fullish length, angling into middle and leg, pushed out to wide mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Shai Hope looks to cut but edges it down onto the deck.
Lungi Ngidi (4-0-16-0) is back on.
Floated up on the stumps, kept out by Powell.
Flatter one around middle, Rovman Powell works it off the back foot toward square leg.
Nagging length around off and this one goes across the right-hander. Rovman Powell gets taken aback a bit but keeps it out off the back foot.
WIDE! Quicker one spilled down the leg side, left alone for a wide.
Gives it a lot more air and floats it outside off, Rovman Powell frees hism arms looking to go big but toe-ends it toward mid off.
Nicely flighted on middle, Powell pushes it toward mid on.

SIX! Picked up and dispatched! This is bowled flatter on off stump, Rovman Powell sits down looking for the paddle but ends up just lofting it all the way over the backward square leg fence for a maximum.
Tabraiz Shamsi to continue...
Length ball around off, dabbed down in front of the cover-region for a quick single.
Perfect length on off stump, Rovman Powell blocks it out in front of mid on.
Bowls it shorter again but takes pace off. Rovman Powell looks to hand back and pull but misse and gets hit on the body.
Good length around the top of off, Rovman Powell blocks it off the front foot.
Shorter one over middle and leg, worked away toward mid-wicket for a single.

A bit of a mix up in the middle but no harm is done. Back of a length on the body, Shai Hope tucks it in front of square leg and looks for one. Temba Bavuma from mid-wicket moves to his right but fumbles and this allows Hope to retract.
Flighted delivery around leg stump, Rovman Powell looks to sweep it away but misses. The ball loops up off the pads to the left of leg slip and the fielder there juggles it a bit before holding on.

DROPPED! A really straightforward chance and Tabraiz Shamsi spills it! Tossed up nicely on middle and leg, Rovman Powell looks to come forward and drives but ends up chipping it to the right of the bowler. Shamsi moves that side but ends up spilling it, it wasn't even hit hard and Shamsi will feel he should have held on.
On leg stump, worked away to square leg.
WIDE! Nagging length on leg stump, turning sharply down the leg side. Rovman Powell leaves it alone for a wide.
Flatter trajectory, bowled around leg stump and this is eased off the back foot in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Nicely floated up on the pads, flicked away through square leg with the turn for a run.
WIDE! Flatter one, turning well down the leg side, wide called.
Slower and a tad shorter, turning onto the pads, Shai Hope stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Full and on middle and leg, pushed toward mid on.
Good length around off, Shai Hope dabs it down with soft hands toward backward point and scampers through for one.
Shorter one on the body, Rovman Powell works it off the hips and down to fine leg for one more.
Slower one, full and outside off, driven square of the wicket to deep cover-point for one.
Good length around the top of off, worked away in front of mid-wicket.
Back of a length, bowled over off stump and Shai Hope gets behind the line to block.
Slower and shorter around leg, worked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter one, turning into the legs, kept out by Hope.
Loops it up nicely outside the off stump, Rovman Powell drags the ball down to fine leg and picks up a single.
Turning onto the pads, worked away through backward square leg for one.
Tossed up on leg stump, Shai Hope leans on and pushes it in front of mid-wicket.
BYE! Floated up on leg stump and turning just down leg, Rovman Powell misses the flick and the ball goes past the keeper as well. The batters cross and it is given as byes.
Excellent running yet again! Back of a length and over off stump, Rovman Powell cushions it off the back foot in front of point and the batters scamper through for the single.
Slower one, back of a length and around off, Rovman Powell hangs back and dabs it down fine of the man at third man and races back for two, good running.
Good length around off, pushed out onto the off side.
Rovman Powell is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man and Nicholas Pooran will be disappointed with that. Gerald Coetzee bangs it in short around off and at a very comfortable height for the batter. Pooran's eyes lit up and he rocks back to muscle it away. Pooran though ends up hitting it flat and hard off the toe end of the bat and picks out Rassie van der Dussen at mid-wicket. Rassie takes a sharp catch at mid-wicket and this is just the breakthrough South Africa would have wanted.
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Gerald Coetzee

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and angled onto the pads, Shai Hope works it 'round the corner for a run.
Shorter one on the body, whipped away off the hips down to deep backward square leg for a single.
A tad shorter on the stumps, Nicholas Pooran goes on the back foot and works it in front of mid-wicket for one.
Flatter again and on the pads, flciked away past square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter, fired into middle, Shai Hope defends it from inside his crease.
Flatter one, angling into middle, worked away off the back foot toward mid-wicket for a run.
Full and drifting onto middle and leg, bunted back to the bowler.
FOUR! Smashed away! Tossed up outside off, Nicholas Pooran steps down the track and creams it through the cover region for a boundary. The 150 is also up for West Indies.
Short and around off, tapped away through cover-point for yet another single.
Back of a length around middle and leg, worked away in front of mid-wicket for a run.
Banged in short again, outside off and this is pulled away really hard toward mid-wicket. The ball goes through the hands of the fielder there and the players get a single.
Short one outside off, Nicholas Pooran looks to fetch and pull but is betaen.

FOUR! An unfortunate bounce for the keeper! Good length, in that channel around off and Nicholas Pooran ends up pushing at it. It is the off-cutter and the outside edge is found. The ball lands in front of Quinton de Kock's left but as he tries to get his gloves behind the ball, the bounce takes it past him and the ball runs away into the fence.
This is pitched up on off stump, angling away, Nicholas Pooran looks to loft it down the ground but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter on the pads, tickled away down to short fine leg for a quick single. It is given as leg byes.
Bowls it full and outside off now, Shai Hope leans on and drives it through cover for a run.
A bit shorter and around off, pushed away onto the off side.
Keeps the lengtn short and bowls it over middle, this is pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A tad shorter on middle and leg, worked away off the back foot to mid-wicket.
This is short and angling down leg, Nicholas Pooran misses out as he just dabs it down to short fine leg.
SIX! Clean strike! Tossed up outside off, Shai Hope hits through the line of the ball and smashes it over long off for a maximum.

Doesn't carry and maybe Gerald Coetzee didn't pick it up either. Tossed up on middle and leg, Nicholas Pooran looks to loft it over long on but mistimes it badly on the bounce to long on. It bounces well in front and a single is taken.
Short again around leg stump, Hope has enough time to rock back and work it past square leg for one.
Just short! Drags the length back and bowls it around leg, Shai Hope looks to work it off the back foot but ends up pushing it uppishly to the right of the bowler.
Very full on middle and leg, Nicholas Pooran drives it on the full and down to long on for a single.
A touch shorter, turning away from leg stump, Nicholas Pooran goes deep in his crease and wrists it to short fine leg.
Short again, slower and around off, staying a touch low as well. Shai Hope looks to pull but is beaten yet again.
Pitched up around off, played on the up but straight to extra cover. Four dots on the trot now!
Back of a length around off, Shai Hope hops back to defend.
banged in shorter and slower around off, Shai Hope looks to take it on but is undone by the lack of pace and is beaten all ends up.
Goes full and straight now, Shai Hope keeps it out.
Shorter and angling down leg, Shai Hope tucks it off the hips through square leg and races back for two runs.
Full and around middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.

THREE WIDES! Floated up on the legs and turning down the leg side. Shai Hope gets drwan in and misses the shot, coming out of his crease as well in the process. The ball though eludes Quinton de Kock as well and they pick up two runs down to fine leg.
Nagging length on middle, Shai Hope gets pushed back and keeps it out.
On middle, flicked away to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Thumped! Floated up again, outside off and Shai Hope just sits down before hammering it over mid off for a boundary. The 50-run stand is also up between these two.
Nicely tossed up on off stump, Shai Hope pushes it firmly to mid off.
Leg bye! Floated up full and on the pads, Nicholas Pooran looks to work it away but the ball goes off the pads toward square leg. They pick up a leg bye.
Good length outside off, angling in a bit, Shai Hope plays a loose shot as he tries to punch it away and the ball zips past the outside edge.
Full and around off, driven straight to extra cover by Shai Hope.
Goes fuller now and tries to angle it in from outside off, Shai Hope strokes it to cover.
Back of a length around off, played off the back foot toward extra cover for a single.
Bowled from around the wicket and angled in from around off. Shai Hope hangs back and pushes it toward deep point for a single. They look for two but decide against it and rightly so.
Slower one, on a good length and around off, Nicholas Pooran waits for it and just nudges it down toward short third man for a single.
Flatter one on middle and leg, kept out off the back foot.
Tosses this one up on a nagging length and around off, Shai Hope leans on and mistimes the drive toward mid on.
Nicely flighted on off and middle, kept out by Shai Hope.
FOUR! Short again and around middle, Shai Hope rocks back and pulls it firmly into the deep square leg fence.
Shorter one on the stumps, this is eased off the back foot down to long on for one.
Tossed up full and on middle, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks break! This has been an entertaining first 15 overs of the game with both sides dealing blows to each other. West Indies were off to a flier with Brandon King and especially Kyle Mayers taking the Proteas bowlers for a ride around the park. But, the hosts managed to come back stronger with 3 quick wickets as well. Since then, Shai Hope and Nicholas Pooran have looked good and it will be interesting to see how the middle phase pans out.
Back of a length from around the stumps and this is pushed out toward cover for a single.
FOUR! This is pitched up outside off, and Shai Hope just reaches out before driving it through the gap at cover-point for a boundary.
Keeps it full and angling down leg, Nicholas Pooran flicks it down to fine leg for a single. A no ball is now called for overstepping and it will be a Free Hit to follow.
A touch fuller and around off, eased away through covers for a run.
Good length around middle, blocked out.

Close but not close enough! length ball around middle, Shai Hope works it away through wide mid on and the batters look for two. Lungi Ngidi there is a bit sluggish to get to the ball but manages to throw it to the bowler. Marco Jansen whips off the bails but the replays show that Nicholas Pooran is well in.
Pitches it up around off, Nicholas Pooran pushes it out toward cover and sets off for a quick single, making it with ease.
Marco Jansen (3-0-32-0) is back on.
Shorter one around off, eased off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and around off, Nicholas Pooran backs away and cuts it straight to point.
Loops it up now, full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran looks to smash the ball away but mistimes the drive to extra cover.
Fliaghted delivery, on a length and around off, Pooran eases it toward cover.
Floated up around middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Tosses it up on a shorter length outside off, turning away, this is hit away through the cover region for one.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes on to bowl now.
Floated up around off, kept out on the off side.
On the pads, Nicholas Pooran works it to the left of short fine leg and the batters scamper through for the single.
Nagging length around middle, Nicholas Pooran goes on the back foot and edges it down with soft hands toward short third man.
Gives it a bit more air and bowls it wide of the off pole, Pooran drives it straight to cover-point.
FOUR! Thumped! Tossed up, full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran hits it flat and hard over mid off for a boundary. Pooran looks like he has a point to prove out there.
Floated up outside off, Shai Hope leans on and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Length again, slanted across the left-hander, left alone by Nicholas Pooran.
Good length on off and middle, Shai Hope hops and flicks it leg side for a run.
WIDE! Shorter and just angling down leg, signalled a wide.
Good length around off, pushed away in front of mid off for a quick single.
Goes full and brings it close to the off stump, Nicholas Pooran tries to repeat the trick but is beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! Put away with disdain! Overpitched outside off, Nicholas Pooran nails the cover drive through extra cover and the ball rockets to the fence.
Banged in short and over leg stump, Nicholas Pooran looks to get inside the line and pull but misses and gets hit on the arm.
Half a shout for lbw and nothing more. Flatter one, down leg, Nicholas Pooran tries to paddle it away but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls toward third man and the batters pick up a single.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Tosses this one up around off, Nicholas Pooran hammers this one away wide of mid off and picks up a boundary.
Floated up around off, bunted out in front of cover for a quick single.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle and leg, Shai Hope gets down on one knee and sweeps it hard through square leg and picks up a boundary.
Flighted delivery, drifted onto the pads, Nicholas Pooran works it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Bjorn Fortuin gets rid of the other set batter now and West Indies in a bit of a slump here. Fortuin fires this one in fuller and on off stump. Brandon King gets a big stride forward looking to make the block but ends up yorking himself. The ball sneaks under King's willow and crashes into off stump. Fortuin gets his second and West Indies are three down now.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Good length around off and nipping away a touch, Shai Hope stays back and blocks it out.
Good length around the top of off, blocked out in front of cover.
Skipper, Shai Hope is in next.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Gerald Coetzee picks up his maiden ODI wicket and he is absolutely pumped up! This is bowled shorter and outside off, getting a bit of an extra kick off the deck. Shamarh Brooks shuffles a bit and gets cramped for room instead as he likes to cut. Brooks ends up cutting too close to the body and gets an inside edge onto the stumps. The bails come off and South Africa get two wickets in quick succession.
Fullish length, bowled from wider of the crease and angling in from around off. Shamarh Brooks looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length and over off, worked away behind square leg for a run.
Pitched up a bit outside off and this is driven square of the wicket to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Slows it up now and bowls it around off, Shamarh Brooks eases it toward point.
WIDE! Slides it just down the leg side and a wide it called.
Tossed up around off, kept out by Brooks.
Floated up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shamarh Brooks is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man! Bjorn Fortuin bowls it flatter again around middle and a bit shorter as well. Kyle Mayers looks to rock back and pull it over deep mid-wicket but ends up hitting it flat. The ball goes quickly toward deep mid-wicket where Ryan Rickelton takes a simple catch. The change of bowling has worked fro South Africa and Mayers departs after a fiery start.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Rickelton b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, kept out by Mayers.
Bjorn Fortuin comes on to bowl and starts off with a flatter one on off, Brandon King hits it down to long off for one.
FOUR! Gerald Coetzee's first over in ODI isn't going as planned. Full and wide, Kyle Mayers reaches out and slices it fine, past the man at third man for another boundary. 18 off that over!
SIX! Muscled away! Short of a length around leg stump, Kyle Mayers swivel-pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum and West Indies are absolutely flying here.
Fuller one on middle, swinging in a touch, Mayers punches it to mid on.
Length again, on the pads and flicked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Length ball around off, hammered away on the up through the cover region for a boundary.
Pitched up on the legs, Brandon King clips it aerially in front of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Starts off with a bit of a loosener, on a good length and angling down leg. Wide called.
Gerald Coetzee comes in as first change on ODI debut.
Another risky single but it's a good hustle in the end. Pitched up on off stump, pushed toward mid off for a quick single.
Good length around off, this is tapped away toward deep point for a single.
Back of a length on the body, King works it off the back foot through square leg for one.
FOUR! Another lovely stroke! Short of a length and outside off, Brandon King stands tall and just punches it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Fuller in length and on middle and leg, driven off the toe end to the right of mid on. Kyle Mayers looks for the single but Brandon King sends him back.
On a good length, angling into middle, Brandon King manages to keep it out.

FOUR! Edged away! Pitches it up yet again in that channel around off and gets Kyle Mayers to drive at it. Mayers gets a thick outside edge well wide of the keeper and into the third man fence for a boundary.
Lovely response from Jansen! Fullish length, in that channel around off and shaping away a touch. Kyle Mayers looks to block but is beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Banged in short and on the body, Kyle Mayers pulls it well in front of square on the leg side and picks up another boundary. Jansen is getting a bit of stick here now.
SIX! Picked up and dispatched! Length again on off stump and in the hitting arc. Kyle Mayers just swings across the line and sends it sailing a long way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Very full and aimed at the toes, Kyle Mayers jams it out in front of short mid-wicket.
Length ball, angled just across the off stump, Brandon King plays it late and with soft hands down to third man for a single.
This is a bit shorter and well outside off, Kyle Mayers looks to cut in front of square on the off side but mistimes it badly.
FOUR! Up and over! Length ball around middle, Kyle Mayers holds his shape and just lifts it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.

Risky single but they get through in the end. Good length around off, bunted out in front of extra cover for a quick single. The fielder there picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. Kyle Mayers though is well in.
Good length around the top of off, Brandon King plays it with soft hands down to cover.
Fuller and on off stump, punched back straight to the bowler.
Pitched up on off, this is driven firmly but straight to mid off.

FOUR! A third boundary in the over and West Indies are up and running here. Banged in short over middle, but it just isn't short enough and Kyle Mayers pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary with ease.
A shout for lbw and it is turned down! Jansen goes full and gets a yorker on the toes. Kyle Mayers looks to jam it out but misses and gets a blow onto the boot. No review taken by Temba Bavuma.
Excellent bumper! This is banged in short and over middle, angling it in. Kyle Mayers looks to take it on but is hurried by the extra bounce and ends up missing it.
Back of a length, angling across, King just steers it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! And again! Fullish length outside off, Brandon King throws his hands at it and slaps it through cover-point for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pitched up around off, Brandon King just leans on and strokes it on the up through extra cover for a boundary.
Good length around middle and leg, Mayers stays back and dabs it out on the leg side.
Just short of a good length and around off, Kyle Mayers looks to play at it but is well beaten.
Length ball on off, this one holds into the deck and Kyle Mayers ends up chipping it through mid off. Temba Bavuma chases it down and keeps it in to save two runs for his side.
Pitched up on the off stump, Kyle Mayers defends it off the front foot.
Good length around the top of off, tapped away toward cover.

Length ball angled a long way across the left-hander and Kyle Mayers throws his hands at it. The ball takes the under-edge and goes to the right of the keeper. Quinton de Kock adjusts well and gets his gloves on it.
A touch fuller and on the stumps, blocked onto the leg side.
WIDE! And again! Shortish length angling down leg and a wide is called.
WIDE! Hard length again trying to attack the body but it is spilled down the leg side.
Great carry through to the keeper. Hard length around off, Brandon King looks to smash it over covers but is well beaten by the additional bounce.

Peach! Pitches this one up in that channel around off, angling it across and gets the ball to shape back in a touch. Brandon King looks to push at it but is beaten on the outside edge. Jansen has overstepped and a no ball is called. Free Hit to follow.
Fuller in length and around off, eased away in front of point for a single and Kyle Mayers is off the mark.
Good length, around middle and cramping the batter for room. Kyle Mayers looks to block but gets hit high on the pads.
Good length on middle, kept out by Kyle Mayers.
Nice start! Starts off with a hard-length delivery, on a right line around off and gets it to seam away a touch. Kyle Mayers tries to get behind the line but ends up playing inside the line.
Marco Jansen to bowl from the other end.
Good length, angling into off and just holding its line, kept out watchfully by Brandon King.
Good length, angling into off, blocked out.
Very full and wide, Brandon King reaches out and drives it wide of the man at deep backward point for a couple of runs. Both King and West Indies are underway!
Good length in that channel outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Nicely bowled! Pitches it a bit further off and gets it to shape away. Brandon King is drawn into the expansive drive but is beaten past the outside edge.
Starts off with a length ball on the fifth stump line, with a hint of movement in the air. Brandon King leaves it alone.

Done with the pre-game formalities! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of South Africa. It will be Kyle Mayers and Brandon King to open the innings for West Indies. Lungi Ngidi has the new ball in hand and is raring to go, but before that, the players from both sides take a knee to show their support for the BLM movement. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of the play but first, the two teams will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the national anthem of the West Indies first followed by the South African national anthem.

South Africa skipper, Temba Bavuma says tha they would have loved to bat first and hopefully it can hold together and they have the opportunity now to restrict the Windies to a decent total. Adds that it's been a good couple of weeks and the guys are feeling well. Mentions that the SA20 in January helped get crowds back in and helped the performances of the players and now it's about keeping a smile on the faces of the fans. Mentions that they have the crucial series against the Netherlands on their mind but will look to do well here. Adds that they have got four debutants in the lineup for this game.

Shai Hope, the captain of West Indies says that they will bat first as the wicket looks dry. Adds that he is happy about the captaincy role and hopes that it's a fresh start. Mentions that they all have a part to play and is happy to get some guys back into the playing XI. On being asked about the World Cup later this year, he says that they know direct qualification in their hands, so it is what it is.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Shai Hope (C/WK), Nicholas Pooran, Rovman Powell, Jason Holder, Odean Smith, Yannic Cariah, Akeal Hosein, and Alzarri Joseph.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Temba Bavuma (C), Ryan Rickelton (On debut), Tony de Zorzi (On debut), Rassie van der Dussen, Tristan Stubbs (On debut), Bjorn Fortuin, Gerald Coetzee (On debut), Lungi Ngidi, and Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of West Indies. They will BAT first.

West Indies haven't had the best time in both forms of white-ball cricket in recent times and this series, away from home against a quality side like South Africa will be a real challenge for them. Newly appointed skipper, Shai Hope would hope to lead from the front and pull off an upset over the hosts. Will the Windies be able to trouble the Proteas in their own backyard? Or will South Africa reign supreme? We shall find out, The toss and team news aren't far away, stay tuned.

South Africa will be pretty buoyant after their stellar display in the Test series against the Windies and have a pretty settled lineup as well in the ODI format. The Proteas will be led by Temba Bavuma who will look to rally his troops to another easy win against the visitors and take a 1-0 lead.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd ODI between South Africa and West Indies at Buffalo Park in East London. The first game of the three-match series was unfortunately washed out without a single ball being bowled and that's what makes this game even more important for both sides. Thankfully, the weather forecast for the day is pretty good and we should get a complete cracker of a game in.
... MATCH DAY ...

Well, the second game of the three-match ODI series as South Africa takes on West Indies at Buffalo Park, East London. After the first game was washed out the two sets of players would be looking to get some action on the field in the second game. South Africa is in excellent form and has momentum having won the test series 2-0. South Africa is missing some important players yet they have a strong squad and would be looking to impose themselves on the opponents. West Indies, on the contrary, are coming into this game after a series defeat against the Kiwis. They have struggled in this format in recent times. Shai Hope will lead West Indies and would be expecting to get some positive results in this series. Hope would be looking for a resolute batting performance. The weather may well act as a spoilsport in this game as well with rain expected. Team selection would be something to look forward to as with the rain around the mix and matchup would be really interesting. Can the visitors shock the hosts with a victory here? Let's see when the two sides collide on Saturday.
